#include <iostream>
#include <string>

int main()
{
    std::string input;
    std::cout << "Enter a string: ";
    std::cin >> input;
    std::string output = "";
    for (size_t i = 0; i < input.size(); ++i)
    {
        if (i < input.size() - 2 && input[i] == 'a' && input[i + 1] == 't' && i == 0)
            output += '@', i++;

            output += '.', i += 2;
        else
            output += input[i];
    }
    std::cout << output;
    return 0;
}
